questions.question_text: According to the annual report, what is the Operating margin (%) for Tradition (within the last period or at the end of the last period)? If data is not available, return 'N/A'.

answer_details.step_by_step_analysis: 1. The question requests the Operating margin (%) for Tradition for the last period as reported in the annual report. This metric typically refers to the ratio of operating profit to revenues, expressed as a percentage. 2. We looked through the context pages and found two references to operating margin. On page 45, the table shows both the "Adjusted underlying operating margin in %" (12.7%) and the "Reported operating margin in %" (9.9%) for the period. 3. Additionally, page 44 confirms that the reported operating margin for the year was 9.9%, reinforcing the metric found on page 45. 4. Given the question simply asks for the Operating margin (%) and does not distinguish between adjusted or underlying, the term is most directly associated with the reported operating margin. 5. Therefore, the operating margin for Tradition as stated in the annual report is 9.9%.
answer_details.reasoning_summary: The annual report lists the Operating margin as 9.9% for the last reported period; this is directly supported by data on pages 45 and 44 where the reported operating margin is clearly stated as 9.9%.
